text: Illustrate the story here: A Bug on the Bus Sib got on the bus. Bob, Gab, and Bim got on the bus. A big bad bug got on the bus. "I can not sit on the bus," said Sib. Sib got up. Bob got up. Gab got up and Bim got up. But the big bad bug did not.
paragraphs: Sib got on the bus. Bob, Gab, and Bim got on the bus. A big bad bug got on the bus.
"I can not sit on the bus," said Sib. Sib got up. Bob got up. Gab got up and Bim got up. But the big bad bug did not.
